market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off environment dominates. Oil near $100 and yen rally create volatility. Stocks slip on inflation fears. Expect 3-5% drawdown in risk assets if Gulf conflict escalates further. Carry trade unwind could trigger 1-2 week liquidity squeeze. Fed hike expectations (UBS: 2 hikes) add pressure. Watch for $120 oil scenario per Goldman.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish but faces memory supply constraints. Copper and energy transition metals benefit from electrification. US fiscal trajectory ($1.25T interest) creates long-term bond market overhang. Trade war normalization uncertain. EV consolidation favors Chinese manufacturers. Gold maintains structural bid from geopolitical fragmentation.
